text:
ana k: heads-up: planning a blue/green handoff tomorrow in the midnight change window (23:50-01:30 UTC). this is a silent cutover for router service in us-west1 only. want final ack + rollback gates.

ravi: outlining plan: warm green pool, shadow 100% traffic (no response), then cohort split: 0.2% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%. 5-12m observation per step.

toni: ask to keep cookie affinity and the session-cookie domain exact-match for first three steps. we'll relax to no-affinity at 20%+ if stable.

ana k: small correction: cookie name is _rwd_sess not session_id. also pin service version tag: svc=router@release-2026-03-01. release notes: https://docs.redwood/notes/2026-03-01-router (contains perf baseline + config diff).

sre-amy: rollback gates (hard): 1) error-rate jump >0.7% absolute over baseline for 3m, 2) p99 latency >600ms sustained 3m, 3) request droprate on any az >0.5%. If any fire -> immediate revert to blue and drain green.

ravi: add soft gate: if small increase in p95 (50-100ms) but error-rate OK, hold and run quick heap/GC checks before advancing.

ops-bot: preflight checklist link: https://ops.redwood/checks/router-bluegreen | runbook: https://ops.redwood/runbooks/router-bluegreen-cutover

ana k: preflight tasks: ensure canary host header is set, certs valid, health probes respond 200 in all zones, IP whitelists updated. I've created PR for nginx cookie change and health probe endpoint: https://git.redwood/router-config/pull/459 (contains config + rollout notes). merge planned at 23:35 UTC.

deploy-bot: rollout job 5239998888 created. state: WARMING_GREEN. will keep progression manual.

ana k: timing: start warm at 23:50 UTC, shadow for 10m, then infra exec to set weights for cohort 0.2% at 00:10. observe 12m, then manual advance. target full cutover by 01:15 latest.

ops-bot: muting noisy metric alerts: muted group "router-health-flap" for 120m (muted_by: ana k). critical alerts still active.

sre-amy: fast rollback command (control plane):

curl -X POST https://router-api/v1/cutover/revert -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN" -d '{"target":"blue","drain_seconds":30}'

ana k: on rollback we do graceful drain (drain_seconds=30) then scale green down to zero. plan to keep logs and sampling enabled for 30m post-rollback for triage.

toni: add: we should tag telemetry spans with rollout_id=5239998888 so we can filter quickly in traces. I'll add that to the deploy job env.

ravi: capacity note: reserve +25% headroom in us-west1 for the window, and ensure autoscaler cooldown is 5m to avoid premature scale-down during step.

deploy-bot: rollout job 5239998888: STEP queued (0.2%). waiting for manual go.

ana k: ok please ack with :eyes: if you'll be present. I will do a 30m preflight in-thread at 23:20 UTC.

ravi: :eyes: I will watch metrics and do the weight changes.

toni: :eyes: I'll manage cookie config and tagging.

sre-amy: :eyes: oncall for the window.

ana k: thanks everyone — keep comms short in thread during window. if we need to escalate, call the SRE pager and post "rollback" command here.
